notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.1.4
notes.content:
Patch notes! This week was a mixed bag of all-around tweaks.



Highlights:

New thornbush visual

Dynamic lighting for environments and encounter types

Improved process-handling

Reduced Nomic start-up time for low-end machines

Various QoL changes and fixes for interactions

Preparation for launch version w/ various back-end service supports

More settings

Various bug fixes

Thanks again to everyone that has helped us catch these bugs. Every bug report is so helpful! Let the countdown to the game launch begin.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.1.3
notes.content:
It's Friday, which means we get some patch notes! This week we wanted to do a few QoL improvements for first-time players.

 
Highlights:

- Main Menu is now sporting a fresh new look

- Made a few game design tweaks to the demo encounters

- Fixed a nasty error causing the game to break for certain locales

- Improved error capture and recovery for the Nomic system

- Initial game loading times improved further



This patch is dedicated to the people who give GUG a go on a random workday evening! We appreciate you taking a bet on us :)

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.1.2
notes.content:
Patch notes for the demo incoming! The big focus this week is on fixing the game hangs due to bad gugs.


Highlights:

Added a couple of guiding arrows to help new players

Encounter round widget moved to bottom left for easier readability

Gug abilities now vary in complexity more

Quality of Life improvements:

The loading screen is now more interesting

The initial game load should now be shorter

Gug generation is now faster and fails less often

Removed game hitch after selecting a reward

Moving a gug to the same spot is no longer an action and will not affect the undo button

Enemy gugs now come in on a smoother difficulty curve

Lots of bug fixes:

Gug abilities are no longer getting duplicated

Gug abilities no longer work after frying

Biome intro and pause screens no longer have incorrect gug images from time to time

Special gugs now appear in the biome intro and pause screens

The UI should no longer break on resolution change

Encounter ability pop ups now show for enemy gugs present on the screen initially

Removed visual jank when undoing actions and fixed issues with undoing cancelled actions

Shoutout to the Plob challenge runners in our community, tirelessly chipping away at finding how to take that little guy to victory! If you want to know what that's about, join us on Discord using the link at the bottom.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.1.1
notes.content:
More demo patch notes! This time, the focus is on improving the UX and we have some much needed quality of life tweaks.

Highlights:

Gugs in the graveyard and in the waves (incoming enemies, but not yet on screen) can no longer affect the battle

There are now small bubbles above attack and health during battles which show how these will change if the player presses "GO/ATTACK" (we call these predictions)

The tooltip has been simplified and made larger so it's easier to read

The gug radar (the widget on the right during battles) now shows the correct gug image. Using that in conjunction with the pause screen allows you to know what's coming.

The game should now be able to launch properly on lower-resource machines

There is now a button in "Settings" that takes you to the folder containing the Player.log file (useful to provide to us when debugging softlocks and various issues)

Various small bug fixes that should make the game softlock less often

This patch is dedicated to the gug hunters, who can't seem to stop the search for the one true omnigug. If you're one of those, consider joining our Discord community!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.1.0
notes.content:
The first patch for the new GUG demo just dropped! You should now be able to get to the point and into guggin' way faster.

Highlights: 

 Getting into an actual run should now be a lot easier:

The game now uses 30% less RAM,

A bug in which GPU was being over-utilised has been fixed,

The loading times should be way faster for users experiencing high delays

The main menu now has a gug garden for you to browse your gugs in,

The encounter start and sequence of animations have been tuned up for a nicer experience,

Mother Morula no longer appears twice in the Amniotic Pool,

The transcendence animation is now the appropriate quality 

Thank you to our GUG players, new and old, to the content creators and streamers that are already diving into the new demo, and especially to our ever-helping Discord community!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.0.6
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/5dc9834473c08044017709f86e23c71f071e67ab.png

The final planned  patch for the GUG demo is here. Don't despair! At the end of this month, we will be announcing more information about the release of the game, such as release date, some features you can expect, as well as when the demo will get a pre-full-release upgrade. In the meantime, enjoy these slight changes:

Improvements:

 Added better error-handling information for amniotic pool failures, as well as catching a rare error that caused some pool's to freeze.
 Added four starting-gug types for first-time amniotic pool users to help with tutorialisation: “fire”, ”water”, “grass”, and “chocolate cake” are all manual keywords. (If you are a veteran player, feel free to type these in for fun ;))

Fixes:

 Fixed settings menu resolution drop-down issue.
 Fixed an item tooltip issue.
 Fixed traits not updating values correctly in the visual.


And, as always, thank you again to our GUG players, our content creators and streamers, and especially our wild and perfectly gug-like Discord community. We have enjoyed sharing this demo with you and look forward to surprising you with what's to come.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.0.5
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/af52e334efd44af11ff45fd74f17b3aaca7fc8b5.png

We pushed a little patch yesterday to handle some of the bugs the community has helped us identify. Although this won't affect most of you, this should make the game broadly more playable. Here are the notes:

Improvements:

 Windowed-mode support and window is now resizable.

Fixes:

 Disabled the damage vignette around the side of wider resolutions.
 Fixed occasional item tooltip not showing description.
 Fixed UI soft-lock bug related to interacting with moved gugs.
 Fixed issue of camera not reseting properly if returning to main menu while zoomed in.
 Fixed issue with double-loading the main menu when leaving from pause screen.


Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo Advent Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/ecddc086e1c599942744a0cef030f4e8f49a6f42.png

Here are the patch notes for the Demo Advent Update. This is the penultimate (major) GUG Demo update (a couple small bug-based patches and device support are expected)! Final update is scheduled for January, and we will have a couple patches before the holidays start. Then we will be completely focused on the full-release. Thanks for playing! Let us know what you think of the changes, or if you spot something we missed.

Improvements:

 gugs effects can now change gug images and spawn gugs with custom images.
 new combat indicators for taking damage, dealing attack, earning glug, and iminent death for both gugs and Mother Morula.
 new attack icon.
 new effect vfx for gug custom effects.
 damage vfx is colored according to the gug.
 settings screen visual revamp.
 cursor changes when hovering over and grabbing a gug.
 added new setting to adjust game speed.
 resized all VFX
 gugs tween in when spawned.
 gugs tween when damanged or healed.
 new incoming gug icon.
 added advent of gug presents.
 battle stats are now recorded per player.


Fixes:

 stats no loner overflow and kill your gugs.
 attack, health, and glug all have correct calculations and max values.
 glug cannot have decimal values.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.0.4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/29540158f466bffa5820235f6ec8e4d52b6af215.jpg

Happy GUG Patch Friday. There is only one improvement and a couple fixes this week. But, the one improvement should give you an overall more holistic game experience during your runs. In the zone screen you can now view the gugs that you will encounter. Here you can inspect their abilities before you forge or before you fight. Additionally, you can now see the encounter types in the zone screen. Enjoy!

Improvements:

 New zone display with: Ecosystem previewing the gugs you will encounter in the zone, improved map progression with iconography for different encounter types.

Fixes:

 Fixed error thrown by team side-view panel when gug destroyed.
 Fixed some builds failing CRC check for addressables.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/0df0f16f26d111071e0757b23767d3997004eae9.jpg

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.0.3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/c39193f79f875f98c47328bcc92b8278218d5400.png

It's GUG patch Friday. This one is full of secrets and speed-ups. The loading times have been a persistent issue and we have made 3 big changes so that the game can better support low-bandwidth internet. In addition to a boggling menu visual, we have also slipped in 9 secret gugs. Time for a gug hunt. Detailed list of changes below:

Improvements:

 Pause screen rearranged.
 New shiny menu screen background.
 Gug images are now webp format for faster download times on slow connections.
 Code compilation is now mulithreaded.
 Coins now move towards the mouse when nearby.
 9 secret gugs added to the game!

Fixes:

 Fix for builds that slowed down realm generation + continue run significantly.
 Fixed UI display for more resolutions: wide screen, non-standard, square.
 Fixed glug not dropping for high attack.
 Fixed wrong gug stats in the shop.
 Corrected VFX timings and fixed heal VFX not firing all the time.
 Fixed arrow indicators when a gug changes team.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/b8e255400329951efa7dfdbdfbd097a351388402.png

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.0.2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/668b56b5d2a8023e8867a0cf2e48b8a27f5bf139.jpg

It's our second GUG patch Friday! All are welcome to gaze upon that which is the improvements and the fixes that have come to the rolling hills and valleys of our great GUG. The world will feel slightly different, slightly more guggy, and we are particularly excited about: Mother Morula finally having a nametag during the battle, faster realm generation time, and a completely overhauled gug movement system that we hope will ease some of the pain-points you all have mentioned.

Enjoy! And let us know if you spot any new issues. A list of all the changes:

Improvements:

 enemy gugs & shop items now have movement arrows to indicate next-turn movement.
 realm generation is 2x faster!
 tweaks to first-time battle to make it more interesting.
 complete redesign of gug drag movement system to use locking and snapping, and bound the limits of the movement.
 prompt text for menu and shop to help first-time users.
 redesign of the battle UI layout for cleaner parsing.
 Mother Morula has a name tag!

Fixes:

 shop potions show health/attack you will gain when buying them.
 broken steam login button fixed.
 fix for when maximum number of transcend retries causes the creation popup to not disappear.
 fixed gugs not FRYING from last patch.
 fixed pause + exit bug when newly transcended gug is being returned.
 GO button is safely locked at the start of battle.
 BUY button fades when not functional.
 removed annoying shadow hovering inside Mother Morula in first-time battle.
 fixed not being able to properly select player selection gug in menu.
 fixed issue with event queue limit in start up.
 fixed issue where if a space already had a gug the overflow panel wouldn't trigger until the next reset.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/41f0d3863fe81dc712658b441042b572ccc3620c.jpg

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.0.1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/17c60874a08cefd011f8c97505f8b882d1d18750.jpg

Our first Friday patch. A tiny update to get some quick robustness improvements in, as well as better analytics so we can begin to help our first-time players on-board better. A list of changes:

Improvements:

 Local gugs in the gug garden will update if the server's gug garden changes.
 Gugs generated in the menu Amniotic Pool will enter the Gug Garden.
 Place-spot red flames transitions to green on hover.
 More detailed event tracking for player FTUE analysis.

Fixes:

 Realm generation throws an error screen if the realm generation fails / no internet connection, and the player can Retry/Return.
 PC names with non-UTF-8 characters no longer cause HTTP requests to fail.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/d6bacf4a5b19d1da632f5395243e354a5a0d0aaa.jpg

notes.title: Demo Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
Hello GUG enjoyers!

Day 2 at Gamescom has gone by in a whirl. We had all four stations permanently in use throughout the entire day. And one person came back on five separate occasions!

And the one question we kept getting: when can we play?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/4d48d7631c45aeaedf6e0b5fab4dcd6f0435af61.png

So we've brought forward our plans and are today announcing that the playable demo will be available from 8th October 2024.

For those interested, that's Ada Lovelace day. We're not clear if she would have been pro-gug, but she did lay the foundations of computing and so we're happy to have picked her day for the launch. 

Wishlist GUG to get an email when the demo drops and visit GUG.gg to make gugs while you wait.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/f23276038383144d67e0218d5ea8dc1da7928eed.jpg
That's a lot of gugs...

- MLC

notes.title: GUG goes to Gamescom 2024 (and other news)
notes.content:
Gamescom 2024 Update and News

Hello GUGgers,

We're holed up in an airbnb in beautiful Cologne, Germany, the night before Gamescom 2024. This is where we unleash the first new public version of GUG since the winter and it has changed beyond all recognition! If you're at the convention, do drop in on us in the Indie Hall 10.2. We have stickers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/185aa024c984c13737ffe5602fd8adaa7d5eeabc.jpg
Gug shown is not to scale.

Here are Levi and Marlon up late working on the latest build. Levi is our game wrangler, Marlon is our gug tamer. Read about Levi and Marlon in our blogs.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/25145ceea1a0fecc46cad012801894c41b80c0a8.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872478/6332421a3868a5ab722207a314e8dd61701ca9de.jpg

And here is unexpected footage of a wild gug which evolved the ability to ask gameshow questions mid game.

[previewyoutube=ZEhfiFSCi_g;full][/previewyoutube]
(We're not even sure we know the answer to all the questions.)

GUG mods its own code, during play, with wild results. Do follow this page if you'd like to be amongst the first to try out this new type of game experience.
 - MLC
